description: PHP class 'JobSpecification' extending AbstractFileController, responsible for handling the download or retrieval of job specification attachments in an HR management system. It includes a service for retrieving attachments by ID and handles HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: JobSpecification
classes.description: Controller class for handling job specification file attachments, extending AbstractFileController to facilitate file download operations.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance used to fetch job specification attachments.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to retrieve a job specification attachment by ID and prepare the response with appropriate file headers and content.
